study.text: Hindsight check (one-off study, Nov 2026): picking the sector winners with only the first year of data (Nov 2024–Nov 2025) and holding them through the second year returned +32% to +51% depending on the semis pick, against +9.9% for the Nasdaq, so the selection method held up out of sample. A walk-forward test that rotated sector winners every quarter on price data alone returned slightly less than holding (+72% vs +74% from May 2025), which is why a swap must pass all four tests. Seven-stock redo (Nov 14, 2026): adding MSFT at 13% and trimming TSM to 22% and the defensives to 13% lowered the two-year return from about +94% to +83%, but cut volatility (15% vs 17%), the worst drawdown (−15.7% vs −16.7%) and downside capture (38% vs 40%), with almost the same Sharpe ratio (2.07 vs 2.11). In the Oct–Nov 2026 selloff the 7-stock mix lost 3.1% against 5.3% for the 6-stock mix.
